from pathlib import Path
import struct
# 1x1 RLE true-color with truncated payload after packet header; likely exercises short read in RLE path.
for name, img_type, extra in [('poc5.tga',10,b'\x00'), ('poc6.tga',11,b'\x00')]:
    hdr = bytearray(18)
    hdr[2] = img_type
    hdr[12:14] = struct.pack('<H', 1)
    hdr[14:16] = struct.pack('<H', 1)
    hdr[16] = 24 if img_type==10 else 8
    Path('/workspace/'+name).write_bytes(hdr+extra)
    print(name, len(hdr)+len(extra))
PY
